# Weft uses the LLVM/MLIR selected by the enclosing Triton build.
set(WEFT_SOURCE_DIR ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
set(WEFT_BINARY_DIR ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR})
set(WEFT_INSTALL_ROOT triton/_C/weft)
set(CMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
if(NOT LLVM_ENABLE_RTTI)
  add_compile_options($<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>:-fno-rtti>)
endif()
include_directories(${WEFT_SOURCE_DIR}/include ${WEFT_BINARY_DIR}/include)
if(NOT TRITON_WEFT_RUNTIME_ONLY)
  add_subdirectory(include)
endif()
add_subdirectory(lib)
if(NOT TRITON_WEFT_RUNTIME_ONLY)
  target_include_directories(WeftRISCVTarget PUBLIC
    ${WEFT_SOURCE_DIR}/include ${WEFT_BINARY_DIR}/include)
endif()
install(TARGETS WeftRuntime LIBRARY DESTINATION ${WEFT_INSTALL_ROOT}/lib)
install(FILES include/weft/runtime.h include/weft/runtime.hpp
  DESTINATION ${WEFT_INSTALL_ROOT}/include/weft)
install(DIRECTORY integrations/llama.cpp/ DESTINATION ${WEFT_INSTALL_ROOT}/share/llama.cpp)
install(FILES cmake/WeftConfig.cmake DESTINATION ${WEFT_INSTALL_ROOT}/lib/cmake/Weft)
install(FILES LICENSE NOTICE THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md
  DESTINATION ${WEFT_INSTALL_ROOT}/licenses)
install(DIRECTORY licenses/ DESTINATION ${WEFT_INSTALL_ROOT}/licenses)

if(CMAKE_LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY)
  set(WEFT_WHEEL_ROOT "${CMAKE_LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}/weft")
  set_target_properties(WeftRuntime PROPERTIES LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${WEFT_WHEEL_ROOT}/lib")
  file(COPY include/weft DESTINATION "${WEFT_WHEEL_ROOT}/include")
  file(COPY LICENSE NOTICE THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md DESTINATION "${WEFT_WHEEL_ROOT}/licenses")
  file(COPY licenses/ DESTINATION "${WEFT_WHEEL_ROOT}/licenses")
  file(COPY integrations/llama.cpp DESTINATION "${WEFT_WHEEL_ROOT}/share")
  file(COPY cmake/WeftConfig.cmake DESTINATION "${WEFT_WHEEL_ROOT}/lib/cmake/Weft")
  if(TRITON_WEFT_CLANG_ROOT)
    if(NOT EXISTS "${TRITON_WEFT_CLANG_ROOT}/bin/clang")
      message(FATAL_ERROR "TRITON_WEFT_CLANG_ROOT must contain bin/clang")
    endif()
    if(NOT EXISTS "${TRITON_WEFT_CLANG_ROOT}/LICENSE.TXT")
      message(FATAL_ERROR "Bundled Clang requires its LLVM LICENSE.TXT")
    endif()
    file(GLOB WEFT_RVV_HEADERS "${TRITON_WEFT_CLANG_ROOT}/lib/clang/*/include/riscv_vector.h")
    if(NOT WEFT_RVV_HEADERS)
      message(FATAL_ERROR "Bundled Clang is missing its RISC-V resource headers")
    endif()
    if(NOT CMAKE_CROSSCOMPILING)
      execute_process(COMMAND "${TRITON_WEFT_CLANG_ROOT}/bin/clang" --print-targets
        OUTPUT_VARIABLE WEFT_CLANG_TARGETS COMMAND_ERROR_IS_FATAL ANY)
      if(NOT WEFT_CLANG_TARGETS MATCHES "riscv64")
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Bundled Clang must contain the RISC-V code generator")
      endif()
    endif()
    file(COPY "${TRITON_WEFT_CLANG_ROOT}/bin/clang" DESTINATION "${WEFT_WHEEL_ROOT}/bin" FOLLOW_SYMLINK_CHAIN)
    file(COPY "${TRITON_WEFT_CLANG_ROOT}/lib/clang" DESTINATION "${WEFT_WHEEL_ROOT}/lib")
    file(COPY "${TRITON_WEFT_CLANG_ROOT}/LICENSE.TXT" DESTINATION "${WEFT_WHEEL_ROOT}/licenses/llvm")
  endif()
  if(TRITON_WEFT_OPENMP_LIBRARY)
    if(NOT EXISTS "${TRITON_WEFT_OPENMP_INCLUDE_DIR}/omp.h")
      message(FATAL_ERROR "Bundled OpenMP requires its public omp.h")
    endif()
    file(COPY "${TRITON_WEFT_OPENMP_LIBRARY}" DESTINATION "${WEFT_WHEEL_ROOT}/lib" FOLLOW_SYMLINK_CHAIN)
    file(COPY "${TRITON_WEFT_OPENMP_INCLUDE_DIR}/omp.h" DESTINATION "${WEFT_WHEEL_ROOT}/include")
  endif()
endif()
